INSERT INTO survey_investigator_re_info (re_name,survey_org_id,survey_org_name,survey_user_id,survey_user_name,total_case_num,total_money,traffic_money,file_money,stay_money,cross_traffic_money,mileage_money,avg_money,re_state,down_time,re_id,re_state_str) SELECT #{reName},tabB.*,tabB.total_money/tabB.totalCase avg_money,1,NOW(),#{id},'待提交发票' FROM (SELECT tabA.survey_org_id,tabA.survey_org_name,tabA.survey_user_id,tabA.survey_user_name,tabA.totalCase, SUM(IFNULL( i.cityin_driving_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.medical_history_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.opc_troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.printing_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.accommodatio_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.cross_driving_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.self_driving_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.other_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.toll_money, 0 )) total_money , SUM(IFNULL(i.cityin_driving_money,0)) traffic_money, SUM(IFNULL( i.medical_history_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.opc_troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.printing_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( i.other_money, 0 )) file_money, SUM(IFNULL(i.accommodatio_money,0)) stay_money, SUM(IFNULL(i.cross_driving_money,0)) cross_traffic_money, SUM(IFNULL(i.self_driving_money,0)+IFNULL(i.toll_money,0)) mileage_money FROM ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT c.survey_info_id ) totalCase, u.survey_org_id,u.survey_org_name,u.survey_user_id,u.survey_user_name, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT u.id ) clockIds FROM survey_user_clock u LEFT JOIN survey_clock_case c ON u.id = c.clock_id left join survey_franchisee f on u.survey_org_id = f.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT( u.clock_time, '%Y-%m' )= #{reDate} and (f.insurance_type = 1 or f.type = 1) GROUP BY u.survey_user_id,u.survey_org_id ) tabA, survey_clock_re_info i WHERE FIND_IN_SET( i.clock_id, tabA.clockIds ) GROUP BY tabA.survey_user_id,tabA.survey_org_id ) tabB;
